'''Dominique Costagliola''' (born 17 May 1954) is a French epidemiologist and biostatistician, deputy director of the Pierre Louis Institute of Epidemiology and Public Health (iPLESP) and is considered a “leading AIDS specialist.”,<ref name="Inserm">{{cite web |title=Dominique Costagliola, 2020 Grand Prize |url=https://www.inserm.fr/en/news/dominique-costagliola-2020-grand-prize/ |website=Inserm |access-date=29 September 2021}}</ref><ref name="Favereau">{{cite news |last1=Favereau |first1=Eric |last2=Zannettacci |first2=Cyril |title=Dominique Costagliola, solide comme un doc |url=https://www.liberation.fr/france/2020/12/28/solide-comme-un-doc_1809823/ |access-date=30 September 2021 |newspaper=[[Libération]] |date=December 28, 2020}}</ref>

==Biography==
She earned a master's degree in [[physics]] from [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] before graduating from [[Télécom Paris]] and defending a thesis in biological and medical engineering at [[Paris Diderot University]].<ref name="Sorbonne">{{cite web |title=Dominique Costagliola Receives the 2020 Inserm Grand Prix |url=http://www.sorbonne-universite.fr/en/news/dominique-costagliola-receives-2020-inserm-grand-prix |publisher=[[Sorbonne Université]] |access-date=30 September 2021}}</ref>

==Career==
Costagliola began working at Inserm in 1982 and began her research in [[HIV/AIDS|HIV]] in 1986.<ref name="Inserm" />

==Honors==
*[[Inserm]] 2020 Grand Prize<ref name="Inserm" />
*Inserm Research Prize in 2013<ref name="Inserm" />
* 1995: Knight of the National Order of Merit<ref name="Sorbonne" />
*2005: Knight of the National Order of the Legion of Honor<ref name="Sorbonne" />
*2006: Louis-Daniel Beauperthuy Prize of the Academy of Sciences<ref name="Sorbonne" />
*2014: Officer of the National Order of the Legion of Honor<ref name="Sorbonne" />
*2017: Member of the Academy of Sciences<ref name="Sorbonne" />
